notes: v2.5.43. The Floor becomes the Production dashboard: a shop map with department and crew boards, builds and their drift, one part traveler against floor, one meaning of late, fixes for missing dates and untracked parts, the progress overview, Timelines with Location and Last touched, stale-work lists, forecasts with On time, need dates and baselines, usual times, one-line progress on CNC cards and travelers, the machine map, Run next suggestions and a shop TV wallboard (each turned on from Engineering > Controls > Floor progress). The eBOM adds placeholder parts, Relocate, and Step with an mBOM ETA; release emails list tools under Tooling and BOM notices fire from every door. The 3D viewer colours an mBOM by its own build and by Step and ETA. CNC Mill queue cards get a Short layout. Also: milestone groups name the right build, lot storage and out-time temperatures, pack units on requisitions, vendor confirms on top, clearer crew and sign-off refusals, ticket mailboxes stay connected, client PO Undo time, and live Websites updates.
